messages.content: You verify skills from execution evidence. Reply with a single JSON object and nothing else.

Environment rules:
  Commands: "go to X", "open X", "close X", "take O from X", "move O to X", "heat O with X", "cool O with X",
  "clean O with X", "use X", "examine X", "inventory", "look". Invalid commands return "Nothing happens."
  Objects and receptacles carry instance numbers ("apple 2", "drawer 3"); goals name only their types.
  An object may be on any receptacle, including inside closed ones (drawers, cabinets, fridge, microwave, safe);
  a closed receptacle must be opened to see and take its contents. The agent holds at most one object.
  Heating uses a microwave, cooling a fridge, cleaning a sink basin, and lamps are turned on with "use".

Task kind: find an object of the requested type and examine it under a lamp of the requested type by holding it and turning the lamp on.

Skill:
```python
import re


def solve(env, goal):
    goal_l = goal.lower()
    m = re.search(r"examine (?:the |a |an )?(.+?) (?:with|under|using) (?:the |a |an )?(.+?)(?:[.!]|$)", goal_l)
    if m:
        obj_type = m.group(1).strip()
        lamp_type = m.group(2).strip()
    else:
        obj_type = "pencil"
        lamp_type = "lamp"
    obj_type = re.sub(r"^(?:a |an |the )", "", obj_type).rstrip(".!")
    lamp_type = re.sub(r"^(?:a |an |the )", "", lamp_type).rstrip(".!")

    def norm(t):
        t = t.lower()
        t = re.sub(r"^(?:a |an |the )", "", t)
        return t.rstrip(".!")

    obj_type = norm(obj_type)
    lamp_type = norm(lamp_type)

    def is_obj(name):
        n = norm(name)
        if n == obj_type:
            return True
        if n.rstrip("s") == obj_type.rstrip("s"):
            return True
        return False

    def is_lamp(name):
        n = norm(name)
        if n == lamp_type:
            return True
        if "lamp" in n and "lamp" in lamp_type:
            if lamp_type == "lamp":
                return True
            return lamp_type in n or n in lamp_type
        return False

    def parse_items(text):
        items = []
        # match "a NAME NUM" optionally separated by commas/and
        for im in re.finditer(r"\ba ([a-z]+) (\d+)", text):
            items.append((im.group(1).lower(), im.group(2)))
        return items

    def current_loc(text):
        # "You arrive at X." or "On the X, you see"
        mm = re.search(r"You arrive at ([^.\n]+?)\.", text)
        if mm:
            return mm.group(1).strip().lower()
        mm = re.search(r"On the ([^,\n]+?), you see", text)
        if mm:
            return mm.group(1).strip().lower()
        mm = re.search(r"In it, you see", text)
        if mm:
            return None
        return None

    def is_closed(text):
        return "is closed" in text.lower()

    def is_open(text):
        return "is open" in text.lower()

    def take(name, num, loc):
        return env.step("take %s %s from %s" % (name, num, loc))

    def go(loc):
        return env.step("go to " + loc)

    def open_rec(loc):
        return env.step("open " + loc)

    def use(name, num):
        return env.step("use %s %s" % (name, num))

    # Get receptacles from initial room description
    room = env.observation
    receptacles = []
    seen_loc = set()
    for mm in re.finditer(r"a ([a-z]+) (\d+)", room):
        name = mm.group(1).lower()
        num = mm.group(2)
        loc = name + " " + num
        if loc not in seen_loc:
            seen_loc.add(loc)
            receptacles.append((name, num))

    # Also include objects in room that might be receptacles? We scan all listed.
    # But if room text is empty (after first look), we may need to use initial observation.
    # We already captured from env.observation which is room description at start.

    found_obj = None
    found_lamp = None

    def scan_loc(locname):
        nonlocal found_obj, found_lamp
        go(locname)
        txt = env.observation
        if is_closed(txt):
            open_rec(locname)
            txt = env.observation
        items = parse_items(txt)
        loc = current_loc(txt) or locname
        for name, num in items:
            if found_obj is None and is_obj(name):
                found_obj = (loc, name, num)
            if found_lamp is None and is_lamp(name):
                found_lamp = (loc, name, num)

    # First pass: visit all receptacles, opening closed ones
    visited = set()
    for name, num in receptacles:
        loc = name + " " + num
        if loc in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(loc)
        scan_loc(loc)
        if found_obj is not None and found_lamp is not None:
            break

    # If object not found, try going to each again and looking more carefully
    if found_obj is None:
        for name, num in receptacles:
            loc = name + " " + num
            go(loc)
            txt = env.observation
            if is_closed(txt):
                open_rec(loc)
                txt = env.observation
            items = parse_items(txt)
            for iname, inum in items:
                if is_obj(iname):
                    found_obj = (current_loc(txt) or loc, iname, inum)
                    break
            if found_obj:
                break

    # If lamp not found, scan for any lamp
    if found_lamp is None:
        for name, num in receptacles:
            loc = name + " " + num
            go(loc)
            txt = env.observation
            if is_closed(txt):
                open_rec(loc)
                txt = env.observation
            items = parse_items(txt)
            for iname, inum in items:
                if "lamp" in iname.lower():
                    found_lamp = (current_loc(txt) or loc, iname, inum)
                    break
            if found_lamp:
                break

    if found_obj is None:
        return

    # Take the object
    loc, name, num = found_obj
    go(loc)
    txt = env.observation
    if is_closed(txt):
        open_rec(loc)
    res = take(name, num, loc)
    if "nothing happens" in res.lower():
        open_rec(loc)
        res = take(name, num, loc)

    # Use the lamp
    if found_lamp is not None:
        lloc, lname, lnum = found_lamp
        go(lloc)
        txt = env.observation
        if is_closed(txt):
            open_rec(lloc)
        use(lname, lnum)
    else:
        # Try using any lamp in inventory? Not possible; try examining held object? 
        # Fallback: go to dresser or desk and use any lamp found there.
        pass

    return
```
